title: duboisia hopwoodii
intro: Duboisia hopwoodii, commonly known as the pituri plant, is a flowering shrub native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used by indigenous Australians for its health benefits, including the relief of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Duboisia hopwoodii are attributed to the removal of mucus and phlegm from the respiratory tract, allowing for easier breathing. The bioactive constituents present in the plant, including solanine glycosides, have been identified as the primary contributors to its therapeutic effects.
